title: Qing Mu of the Soul Refining Sect
summary: The Giant Demon Clan ancestor, whose body was ruined by Sun Tai, takes over a clansman's body and binds Wang Lin's sword spirit Xu Liguo as his own. Wang Lin joins the Soul Refining Sect in Pilu Country as an outer disciple named Qing Mu, bribing the outer manager Hong Maozi with a sword. Under manager Chang Dawei, Wang Lin learns that the sect's power rests on its soul flags and that only the winner of the outer-disciple contest held every three years enters the inner sect. By breaking the barrier around the Kun Crystal that feeds his cave, he climbs back to late Foundation Establishment. When Chang Dawei grows suspicious and tries to rob him, Wang Lin turns the tables. He then uses the pressure of the sect's spirit vein mine to smash his seal, rising through Core Formation to the peak of mid Nascent Soul in one night.
events: The Giant Demon Clan ancestor seizes a clansman's body and binds Xu Liguo as his sword spirit
Wang Lin bribes Hong Maozi with a sword and is admitted as outer disciple Qing Mu

cultivation: Hong Maozi and Chang Dawei: early Core Formation. Wang Lin climbs from late Foundation Establishment through early, mid and late Core Formation to early Nascent Soul and the peak of mid Nascent Soul.
